assumptions.layout: Provisional v3 (2026-09-13): inside the legal parcel 355/10 + 355/368. Candidates on every 4 m contour of the knoll, scored by the water each can see over the 1 m LiDAR, chosen for view, 21 m spacing and slope; each plot re-checked with the neighbouring houses standing. Three plots on the flat by Rødbergsveien without sea view. Replace with the regulation plan when it exists.
assumptions.sun: Terrain shading only (field cleared, no shading between houses). Eye = floor + 1.6 m, floor = ground + 0.6 m. 0.25 deg solar-disc margin. Times in CET.
assumptions.view: Water counted where the line of sight reaches a sea-level cell; 'open sea' = water beyond 7 km. Refraction k = 1.17. Neighbouring houses (ridge 5.6 m) included as obstacles.
